`enum StencilFunction`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StencilFunction.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/StencilFunction.java)

The comparison of a stencil test between the masked reference and the masked stored value.

## Description

Each value matches the OpenGL function of the same name, with the reference on the left: `LESS` passes when the reference is lower than the stored value.
The order of the constants is part of the contract: [`StencilEmulation`](/reference/pipeline/stencilemulation/) sends their ordinal to the shader.

## Learn more

- [Stencil](/build/framebuffers-and-depth/#stencil)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`NEVER`](#StencilFunction-value-NEVER) | The test always fails. |
| [`LESS`](#StencilFunction-value-LESS) | Passes when the reference is lower than the stored value. |
| [`LESS_EQUAL`](#StencilFunction-value-LESS_EQUAL) | Passes when the reference is lower than or equal to the stored value. |
| [`GREATER`](#StencilFunction-value-GREATER) | Passes when the reference is greater than the stored value. |
| [`GREATER_EQUAL`](#StencilFunction-value-GREATER_EQUAL) | Passes when the reference is greater than or equal to the stored value. |
| [`EQUAL`](#StencilFunction-value-EQUAL) | Passes when the reference equals the stored value. |
| [`NOT_EQUAL`](#StencilFunction-value-NOT_EQUAL) | Passes when the reference differs from the stored value. |
| [`ALWAYS`](#StencilFunction-value-ALWAYS) | The test always passes. |
